KamiCreative 1.1.0 is all about being easy to learn.

## Download

**KamiCreative-Setup-1.1.0.exe** below — Windows 10/11, 64-bit. Run it, choose where to install, and start KamiCreative from the Start menu or desktop. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm: choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## New in 1.1.0

- **Interactive tutorial.** Five minutes, step by step: it highlights where to click, explains each part in plain words, and waits while you try it. Start it from the Welcome screen or Help → Interactive tutorial.
- **Welcome screen** with the tutorial, recipes, examples and your recent projects.
- **Eight one-click recipes**: Play a video, Show a picture, Generative visuals, Webcam with effects, Text title, Music-reactive shape, Fade between two looks, Button that flashes.
- **Hover help** — point at anything and the bar at the bottom explains it.
- **Smart adding** — select a module and add an effect: it is placed after it and wired in automatically.
- **Stage hints** — if your picture is not reaching the screen, KamiCreative tells you why and offers a one-click fix.

Everything from 1.0.0 is still here: 106 modules, scenes with cross-fades, the Live view, multiple outputs, projection mapping, MIDI, OSC and Art-Net. See the [changelog](https://github.com/terpenesalad/kamicreative/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) and the [user guide](https://github.com/terpenesalad/kamicreative/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
